# Version 4.158.0
> **Skia m158 and text shaping** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.158.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.158 introduces Skia m158, with later collected GPU fixes and a HarfBuzz 15.0.0 update. Preview 1 retains the managed API surface and native HarfBuzz 14.4.0. Subsequent collected work corrects hairline and text rendering, bounds Graphite clip recording and expands HarfBuzzSharp's named script constants.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m158** — Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 158 without adding C bridge exports or changing the managed SkiaSharp API. Preview 1 pairs it with HarfBuzzSharp package revision 14.4.0.300, retaining native HarfBuzz 14.4.0. ([#5634](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5634))
- **Later HarfBuzz 15.0.0 update** — Subsequent collected work upgrades bundled HarfBuzz and resets HarfBuzzSharp and NativeAssets package versions to 15.0.0, while retaining assembly version 1.0.0.0. This upgrade is not part of Preview 1. ([#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))

## Bug Fixes

- **Correct reflected hairlines and GPU text** — Later collected fixes preserve device-space square-cap size for zero-length hairlines under reflected transforms, guard non-finite calculations, and round ordinary and LCD text-atlas indices to avoid selecting the wrong texture. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669))
- **Targeted Vulkan device-loss cleanup workaround** — Adds a 1 ms delay on affected Ganesh and Graphite loss paths for ARM proprietary drivers from 42.0 up to, but not including, 56.0, without delaying ordinary successful submissions. Affected-device behavior was not specifically established by the integration review. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669))
- **Bounded Graphite clip recording** — Flushes based on effective undrawn clip elements to stay within render-pass limits. A draw whose clips cannot fit even in a fresh pass is rejected and logged rather than overflowing pass structures. ([#5669](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5669))

## API Surface

- **More named HarfBuzz scripts** — The later HarfBuzz update adds 30 Script constants, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal, for 179 named values. Existing values, parsing, numeric conversions and horizontal-direction lookup remain intact; removing an unused internal deprecated import removes no public managed member. ([#5554](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5554))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.300

Preview 1's HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.300 package retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 and has no public API diff. Later collected work updates HarfBuzz and its packages to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script constants without changing the existing struct-based programming model.

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Preview 1 introduces the Skia m158 engine without changing the managed API surface. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.300 while native HarfBuzz remains 14.4.0; the HarfBuzz 15.0.0 update and subsequent GPU fixes are outside this shipment.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1...v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2)
